## Skills demonstrated

### Full-stack & APIs
- Ass#1: Spring Boot RESTful Web Services — Java SpringBoot, REST API, MySQL, Postman
- Lab Activity: Docker Image Deployment — Docker, Node.js, Containerization, Docker Compose
- This site — Qwik, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GitHub Pages CI/CD

### Cloud (AWS)
- Ass#2: AWS Deployment Guide — AWS, EC2, S3, RDS, Cloud Hosting

### Containers & DevOps
- Ass#3: Intro to Docker & Containerization — Docker, Containerization, DevOps, Learning Plan
- Ass#4: Narrative Report - Virtualization vs. Containerization — Research, Virtualization, Docker, Edge Computing
- Lab Activity: Docker Image Deployment — Docker, Node.js, Containerization, Docker Compose

### Orchestration & IaC
- Ass#5: Kubernetes Home Lab Activity — Kubernetes, Minikube, MySQL, WordPress, PVC, Secrets
- Ass#6: Terraform Survivor — Terraform, Game Dev, IaC, GitHub Actions

## Projects

1. Ass#1: Spring Boot RESTful Web Services — User Management REST API with layered architecture, MySQL integration, and Postman testing.
   PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-1.pdf
   Tags: Java SpringBoot, REST API, MySQL, Postman

2. Ass#2: AWS Deployment Guide — Guide for website hosting using AWS EC2, S3, and RDS.
   PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-2.pdf
   Tags: AWS, EC2, S3, RDS, Cloud Hosting

3. Ass#3: Intro to Docker & Containerization — Two-week learning plan for Docker fundamentals, multi-container apps, and best practices.
   PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-3.pdf
   Tags: Docker, Containerization, DevOps, Learning Plan

4. Lab Activity: Docker Image Deployment — Node.js web app containerized with Docker; build, run, and Compose workflows.
   GitHub: https://github.com/Iron-Mark/Elec3-Docker
   Tags: Docker, Node.js, Containerization, Docker Compose

5. Ass#4: Narrative Report - Virtualization vs. Containerization — Comparative analysis of VMs and Docker containers in edge computing.
   PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-4.pdf
   Tags: Research, Virtualization, Docker, Edge Computing

6. Ass#5: Kubernetes Home Lab Activity — Minikube deployments, services, debugging, and WordPress/MySQL with PVCs and Secrets.
   PDF: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Portfolio-Cloud-DevOps/files/Project-Ass-5.pdf
   Tags: Kubernetes, Minikube, MySQL, WordPress, PVC, Secrets

7. Ass#6: Terraform Survivor — Browser survival RPG where Terraform controls difficulty; IaC, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages.
   GitHub: https://github.com/mark-siazon/AE3-Terraform_Survivor | Demo: https://mark-siazon.github.io/AE3-Terraform_Survivor/
   Tags: Terraform, Game Dev, IaC, GitHub Actions
